correctness.rationale: For fixed b, L_b(x)=x³+bx is additive and bijective unless b=−r² for r≠0; in the exceptional stratum its kernel is {0,±r}, image r³(y³−y) equals a trace-zero hyperplane. Each irreducible cubic has no Fq root, equivalent to nonzero trace λ_r(c+h). Nonzero functionals λ_r cover all nonzero dual vectors as r ranges over Fq×, each b appears twice. Each λ has (q/3)(3−|λ(H)|) allowed constants; inclusion–exclusion of equal λ-values gives the labeled affine rank formula. Existence is disjointness from a dual affine hyperplane; equality-case complement and triple dichotomy follow. Independent GF3 and GF9 enumeration checks every nonempty H and direct root counts, including complements, but analytical trace pairing handles all s.
